text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I went out into town with Dants Flame on our day off...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: T-The "Milky Sweets Fair"...!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Mille crêpes, milk pudding, and
cheesecake...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Waaah~! Looks so yummy~~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
I especially love dairy products like this...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I spot a sign in town like 'New Cheesecake!',
I make sure to look it up right away.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, I've become quite knowledgeable about the world of milk sweets!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Though, my Umastagram feed has become
nothing but sweets now……
It's pretty tough holding back. Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: To think a fair like this was happening so close by! My research was sorely lacking...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
As a milk lover, I can't overlook any of this...!
But still, the calories are just...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...It's already so round as it is, and now this...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh! N-No, it's nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's disappointing, but... I'll hold back this time.
Come on, let's get going!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Endure it... Endu... Mmmph!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...To agonize this much, she must really want to eat it.
In that case..."
choice_data_list: Just one small one, and you'll have to make do with that!
Don't hold back, just eat it!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: J-Just one thing...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Then, Trainer...
may I ask you to help me?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I want you to watch over me by my side
so that I can properly hold myself back!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If it's just one, training might fix it...!
So, please help me out!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mmm~! Thith ith tho thasty~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dantsu Flame successfully enjoyed just one milk pudding.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure!?
choice_data_list: You'll be able to work that much harder in training, right?
You'll be able to work that much harder in training, right?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Indeed... That's right, exactly!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Alright, understood!
I'm going to enjoy today to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Fufun, cheesecake and cream puffs~♪

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, cheesecake for you too, Trainer!
I totally get it~, you just can't help but be curious!
choice_data_list: It looked so good, I couldn't help it...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Fufu, isn't it~~! Sweet, rich... I just love it too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, hands together~...
Ready, set—thanks for the food~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dantsu Flame happily stuffed her cheeks with tons of sweets!
